newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM, Domtar in technology pact.
newsitem.headline: UPM, Domtar in technology pact.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene said on Monday it planned to enter a paper-coating technology pact with Canadian paper producer Domtar Inc.

"The largest European forest industry company, UPM-Kymmene of Finland, has decided to enter into a coating technology and know-how transfer agreement with Domtar Inc," UPM-Kymmene said in a statement.

"This relationship with Domtar, a well-established North American paper company, will enable UPM-Kymmene to commercialise its coating technology expertise," UPM's chief executive Juha Niemela said in the statement.
"This agreement will help UPM-Kymmene advance its knowledge of the North American business environment and fiber base," Niemela said.
